item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Amaya looks at the diagram. Point $O$ lies on a straight line, and a right angle is to be built at $O$.

Which plan correctly constructs the $90^\circ$ angle at $O$?

options.A: Mark points $X$ and $Y$ on the line at equal distances from $O$ so that $O$ is the midpoint of $XY$, then construct the perpendicular bisector of $XY$.
options.B: Keep $O$ on the line and draw any upright ray from $O$.
options.C: First draw a line that looks upright through $O$, then mark equal distances from $O$.
options.D: Treat $O$ as a point off the line and drop a perpendicular from outside.
